pull_request.title: Tracker: Investigate long-strip stereo sandwiches and endcap layouts
pull_request.head: research/long-strip-modules
pull_request.body:
Long-strip sandwiches need both hits in the same module, while stereo rotation and sensor separation change their coverage, mounting and cooling envelopes. DES-008 provides an isolated analytical PROTOTYPE following the short-strip comparison in #21.

The study now matches **both active A/C1 layouts in #13**, pinned at `f57e26e83b826867c2720edcd702e808fe946854`: **710–1100 mm target annulus**, first long-strip disk **z=1430 mm**, and all six disk positions through |z|=3120 mm. The original 700 mm / 1320 mm evidence is preserved in Git at `68932692fc61bb25d21e55a915a12eb929b2b316`.

The common geometric working candidate retains **six rings of 96×96 mm² continuous-strip sandwiches: 404 pairs/disk**, 40 mrad relative stereo and 5 mm sensor mid-plane separation. It has zero missing pairs on both tested grids and direct inner/outer-boundary samples at every disk position, and zero intersecting trial bodies. Five rings lose coverage at the first three disks (worst 1.0914%), so they are not adopted as the common arrangement. Six ring-specific wedges use 360 pairs and about 4.2% less silicon. Roughly 96–100 mm strip electronics/noise/occupancy remain unqualified.

Mounting compatibility is bounded: the square's trial body extends inward to **687.55 mm**, so the nominal 10 mm separation of active bands is not an empty radial service corridor. The checked short/long disk trial envelopes retain **18.85 mm axial separation**, with **14.35 mm** between the first disk body and ideal barrel end and between the last disk body and host end. Shared carriers, services and barrel-end structures remain unmodeled.

Other retained controls expose:

- Inactive seams with two ~48 mm rows; coverage and mounting conflicts with separate 48 mm modules.
- Internal cooling-stack failure at 1.8/4 mm gaps and neighboring-body conflicts at 6.6/10 mm with fixed staggering.
- Failure of PR21's 3 mm stagger spacing; nominal four-level depth is 31.3 mm before common supports/manifolds.
- Pair parallax, zero-stereo singularity, covariance, pairing ambiguity and barrel-reuse limits.

Includes pinned ODD/ATLAS/CMS provenance, an exact geometry-only extraction of both PR13 layouts with source hash, executable studies and results, figures, TRK-LSTRIP tracking and session records. No unmerged branch is imported; earlier evidence remains traceable.

Validation: **14 geometry/layout tests, 27 dashboard tests and 32 logging tests passed**, dashboard validation/build and **44 session records validated**. The original investigation also passed 14 JavaScript assertions. Both sampling grids, three vertex fixtures, all six disk positions, boundary enumeration, angle/gap/mounting scans and source-hash comparisons were executed. No DD4hep/Geant4/ACTS or engineering qualification and no human sign-off. Exact active-turn token usage remains unknown.

Governing: DES-005 / DES-008, TRK-LSTRIP, TRK-CONTRACT, TRK-SUPPORT and TRK-COOLING. Related layout study #13 and short-strip investigation #20 / #21; none is closed by this PR.

events.text:
Added DRAFT DES-008 and a NumPy analytical PROTOTYPE. Compared seven layouts in
a provisional 700–1100 mm annulus, at 40 mrad relative stereo and 5 mm sensor
mid-plane separation. Three continuous-strip six-ring candidates have zero
sampled pair gaps and zero intersecting trial bodies on two grids and three
straight-ray vertex fixtures. The 402-pair 96 mm square is a conditional geometric
working candidate; 358-pair wedges use six outline types and about 2.6% less
silicon. This does not qualify ~96–100 mm strip electronics or occupancy.

Retained failures: split-square row seams; twelve-ring shorter modules;
fourteen-ring mounting conflicts; five-ring square coverage losses. The gap
scan distinguishes internal cooling-stack failure at 1.8/4 mm from occupied
body collisions at 6.6/10 mm with fixed 8 mm stagger spacing. PR21's 3 mm spacing
and enlarged mounting tabs are explicit collision controls. Neither projection
coverage nor two unassociated sensor hits establishes a usable stereo pair.

Kept all geometry isolated. No production XML, reconstruction, material mixture,
geometry envelope, accepted evidence or human approval was changed. Updated
TRK-LSTRIP as active with next actions, DES-008 and its evidence; other ongoing
work stays unchanged. Source facts are pinned ODD and locally hash-verified
ATLAS/CMS TDR passages with precise locators, separated from unsigned choices.
Live CDS records returned a challenge; local/public byte equality is not claimed.
